sources.title: 16 Del. Admin. Code § 3102 — Long Term Care Transfer, Discharge and Readmission Procedures
sources.notes: Despite the /api/ path this URL serves a PDF directly to plain curl (200, no browser user-agent needed) -- the endpoint is Delaware's own regulation-viewer API, not a JSON API; regulations.delaware.gov returns 405 to HEAD but 200 to GET. pdftotext -layout matches the standing packet's own extraction closely: tested against pdftotext's plain/default mode first, which loses the section-number tabular indentation ('1.0      Purpose' collapses to '1.0\n\nPurpose'), so layout is the correct mode for this document's numbered-section format. The standing packet strips this 5-page document's repeated letterhead ('TITLE 16 HEALTH AND SAFETY', 'DELAWARE ADMINISTRATIVE CODE', 'DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND SOCIAL SERVICES', 'DIVISION OF LONG TERM CARE RESIDENCE PROTECTION') more thoroughly than strip-running-headers manages on a document this short (the filter leaves the 2-line short form of the header standing on pages 2-5, only removing the fuller 4-line block from page 1) -- this is a cosmetic difference in incidental non-quoted letterhead text, not a fidelity risk, since none of the page's quotations rest on those lines. Verified byte-identical on a second capture run.

sources.title: Contact the Division of Health Care Quality (DHCQ)
sources.notes: WordPress page; .entry-content is the article body and excludes the site's nav, breadcrumb list and sidebar link menus, which the standing packet's own wider capture included and which contribute nothing this page quotes. Contains all three of this page's DHCQ contact facts: (302) 421-7400, the 1-877-453-0012 hotline, and the full New Castle and Kent/Sussex office addresses. Plain curl, no browser user-agent needed (200).

sources.title: DHSS Long Term Care Institutional Provider Specific Policy Manual, Section 4.5, Temporary Absences for Hospitalization
sources.notes: 16 Del. Admin. Code 3102-3.9.1.1 (Source 1) points to this manual by name and section number for the state bed-hold duration ('See DHSS Long Term Care Institutional Provider Specific Policy Manual at Section 4.5'). Located by EntryId probing on medicaidpublications.dhss.delaware.gov's DNN download endpoint (a plain GET, no session token or query hash beyond the numeric EntryId and fixed portal/tab parameters that do not vary by document): EntryId 900 returns Content-Disposition filename "Long Term Care Provider Specific.pdf" and its own running header reads "Long Term Care Institutional / Provider Specific Policy Manual", matching the regulation's citation exactly (EntryId 898, tried first on the same host, is a different manual, "Long Term Care Community Services Provider Specific"). Plain curl with a browser user-agent returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/pdf; no browser render needed. from_occurrence 2: the heading '4.5 Temporary Absences for Hospitalization' appears once in the manual's own table of contents and once at the body heading two pages later; occurrence 2 lands on the body heading (verified: the revision-table's row for 9/1/2016, 'Updated Temporary Absences for Hospitalization policy for...', has 'Updated' between '4.5' and 'Temporary' and so does not match this anchor -- only the TOC and the body heading do). 'to' defaults to occurrence 1 because apply_slice searches for it only in the text after the 'from' match ends, and the sibling TOC line for '4.6 Temporary Absence for Other Reasons' falls before that point, not after it -- the body heading two pages on is therefore the first (and only) match remaining. The slice keeps 4.5.1, 4.5.1.1 and 4.5.2, 4.5.2.1 whole -- the 7-day (nursing facility) and 14-day (ICF/IID) bed-hold periods -- and stops before 4.6, which is unrelated (leave for reasons other than hospitalization).
